Hi Elliot / DataHarbor team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion on workload characteristics and compliance requirements. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth and clear owners: please review and reply with preferred items and any missing constraints.

Summary of ask: run a 2-week hands-on trial to validate latency, throughput, and data handling across a representative traffic mix. Evaluate (a) model quality for your prompts, (b) per-token cost at target throughput, and (c) observability/traceability for audit purposes.

Options we discussed for environment:
- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest to start, no infra work; we recommend for feature validation and early perf metrics.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): predictable throughput and isolated instance for sustained load tests; minimal network config.
- VPC trial (private deployment): required if you need customer-managed networking or HSM/KMS integration for keys. Longer setup time (typically 5–10 business days).

Initial recommendation: start with Hosted for the first 2 weeks (low friction), escalate to Dedicated sandbox for the sustained load test, and evaluate VPC only if KMS/HSM or strict inbound firewall policies are mandatory.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or update):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 220ms for single-turn completions at 1k RPS equivalent token mix.
- Cost: unit cost per 1k tokens within 20% of our forecast for your workload.
- Quality: pass on set of 12 prompt-driven prompts (fidelity >= 8/10 per your rubric).
- Observability: request->response trace + token-level cost breakdown available in Console; 30-day eval retention.

Proposed timeline and owners:
- Today (Marissa) — share trial checklist + architecture diagram (attached).
- Wed Jan 13 (Karthik) — technical kickoff to validate network egress/IP allowlists and file requirements.
- Week of Jan 18 — Hosted trial starts (2 weeks).
- Week of Feb 1 — dedicated sandbox run (if requested).

Immediate asks for DataHarbor:
1) Confirm preferred starting environment (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC).
2) Outcome owner for quality rubric and a short list of 12 representative prompts.
3) Procurement contact and any procurement timelines (Ben, cc'd, will follow).
4) Any non-standard security constraints (e.g., need for HSM, restricted egress) that would require VPC.

Attachments: trial-arch-diagram.pdf (high-level network/flow), redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx (ops checklist).

Thanks — I can book the kickoff once you confirm the environment.

Best,

- Cost signals: Console shows per-token cost within expected parameters and batching is working as designed.
- Logs: access to request-level tracing and token-level spend breakdown for the trial period.
